company_name: Taiwan Aerogel Technology Materials Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Taiwan Aerogel Technology Materials Co., Ltd. specializes in aerogel products that can be utilized in semiconductor applications, particularly in insulation and fireproofing.
summary: Taiwan Aerogel Technology Materials Co., Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of aerogel products, focusing on applications in fireproofing, high-temperature insulation, and lightweight solutions. Their innovative offerings include aerogel powder, insulation blankets, and thermal insulation boards, which are relevant for the semiconductor industry.

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company is headquartered in the Tainan Science Park and focuses on domestic and international collaborations.
